onboarding.subtitleClipper: One time only, under 2 minutes. Then you can start taking campaigns.
onboarding.subtitleBrand: This profile is used when you manage campaigns and your brand team.
onboarding.legalMissingBody: The terms or privacy policy have not been published yet. Try again later or contact support.
onboarding.usernameHelper: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dots, or underscores.
onboarding.usernameTaken: Username is taken. Try another one.
onboarding.usernameInvalid: Use 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dots, or underscores.
onboarding.displayNameHelper: Shown on your public profile and leaderboards. Max 50 characters.
onboarding.adult: I am 18 years old or older
onboarding.adultHelper: Your age is checked again from your NIK during KYC.
onboarding.tosClipper: I agree to the <link>Clipper Terms & Conditions</link> (version {version})
onboarding.tosBrand: I agree to the <link>Brand Terms & Conditions</link> (version {version})
onboarding.privacyHelper: Including data processing on servers in Singapore.

invite.title: Brand team invite
invite.body: You have been invited to join a brand organisation on Clipper.
invite.bodyOrg: You have been invited to join {org} as {role}.
invite.what: Once you accept, you can help manage campaigns, review clips, or handle billing depending on the role the organisation owner gave you.
invite.askNewLink: Ask the organisation owner for a new invite link.

hub.title: Your account
hub.description: Identity, bank accounts, security, and personal data for the clipper and brand apps.
hub.kyc_pending: Our team is reviewing it. You will get a notification.
hub.kycRejected: Rejected: {reason}. Fix it and submit again.
hub.methodCount: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
hub.methodsNone: Add a bank account or e-wallet to receive payments.
hub.methodsSome: Account numbers are stored encrypted and always shown masked.
hub.mfaOnBody: An authenticator app protects brand money actions.
hub.mfaOffBody: Required for brand refunds and budget rollovers.
hub.consentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No agreements yet} one {# active agreement} other {# active agreements}}
hub.privacyBody: Manage agreements, download your data, or delete your account.
hub.noProfileBody: Pick a username and accept the terms to start using the app.

kyc.title: Identity verification (KYC)
kyc.description: One time only. Used for withdrawals and tax obligations.
kyc.pendingBody: Our team is checking your ID card, usually within 24 hours. You can already add a bank account.
kyc.approvedBody: You can withdraw to accounts in the same name.
kyc.rejectedBody: Reason: {reason}. Fix your details or upload a clearer ID photo, then submit again.
kyc.legalNameHelper: Write it exactly as on your KTP. The bank account holder name must match.
kyc.legalNameInvalid: Letters, spaces, dots, commas, apostrophes, or hyphens only (2–100 characters).
kyc.nikBirth: Birth date from NIK: {date} ({age} years old)
kyc.nikUnderAge: Age from NIK is {age}. You must be 18 or older.
kyc.nikInvalid: Invalid NIK. Check the 16 digits again.
kyc.photoHelper: Whole card visible, text readable, no glare. JPG, PNG, or WebP.
kyc.photoPick: Choose or take a KTP photo
kyc.photoTypes: Large photos are resized automatically (max 5 MB)
kyc.consent: I agree to my ID data being processed for identity verification
kyc.consentBody: Your name, NIK, and KTP photo are stored encrypted, only opened by the verification team, and used for payments and taxes under the Privacy Policy.
kyc.submitted: KYC submitted. We will let you know once it is reviewed.

payout.title: Bank accounts & recipients
payout.description: Where withdrawals go, and recipient details for physical rewards.
payout.emptyBody: Add a bank account or e-wallet in your own name.
payout.addDescription: The holder name must match the name on your KTP.
payout.kycNeededBody: Accounts can be added once your ID details are submitted.
payout.kycRejected: Your KYC was rejected. Fix it and submit again before adding an account.
payout.phoneHelper: The number registered with the e-wallet, e.g. 0812xxxxxxxx.
payout.phoneInvalid: Use an Indonesian mobile number starting with 08 or +62.
payout.holderMismatch: Holder name must match your KTP name ({name}).

recipient.title: Recipient details: {reward}
recipient.description: Address and phone are stored separately and encrypted, and only shared with the brand to deliver this reward.
recipient.notFound: Reward not found. Go back to the wallet and try again.
recipient.noneNeeded: This reward does not need an address or phone number.
recipient.hint: Recipient details for physical rewards (address, phone) are requested when you claim a reward in the app wallet.
recipient.share: Share recipient details with the brand to deliver rewards
recipient.shareBody: You can withdraw this any time in Privacy & data. Without it, physical rewards cannot be delivered.
recipient.shareActive: You already allow recipient details to be shared with brands for reward delivery.

security.title: Security
security.description: Two-step verification (TOTP) for actions that move brand money.
security.enrollBody: Required for brand refunds and budget rollovers. Use Google Authenticator, 1Password, or a similar app.
security.challengeBody: Your authenticator is already set up. Enter a code to unlock actions that need MFA.
security.activeBody: This session is verified with two steps.
security.lost: Lost your phone or authenticator app? Contact support to reset MFA after we check your identity.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.description: Your rights over your personal data under Indonesian law (UU PDP): review agreements, download your data, or delete your account.

hints.tos_clipper: Needed to use the clipper app.
hints.tos_brand: Needed to use the brand app.
hints.age_18_plus: Needed to use the clipper app.
hints.kyc: Needed for identity verification and withdrawals.
hints.share_with_brand: Allow it so brands can ship physical rewards to your address.

revokeEffect.tos_clipper: You cannot use the clipper app until you agree again.
revokeEffect.tos_brand: You cannot use the brand app until you agree again.
revokeEffect.privacy: You cannot use the clipper or brand app until you agree again.
revokeEffect.age_18_plus: You cannot use the clipper app until you confirm again that you are 18 or older.
revokeEffect.kyc: KYC data already submitted is kept for tax obligations. Future verification and withdrawals need this agreement.
revokeEffect.share_with_brand: Brands will not receive your address or phone number, so physical rewards that need recipient details cannot be claimed.

privacy.downloadDescription: One JSON file with your profile, KYC, bank accounts, agreements, submissions, balance, withdrawals, and notifications.
privacy.deleteDescription: Permanent. Your balance must be withdrawn and no withdrawal or reward claim may be in progress.
privacy.deleteBody: Your profile is anonymised, social accounts are disconnected, and ID and bank data are deleted except what must be kept for taxes. This cannot be undone.

errors.username_taken: Username is taken. Pick another one.
errors.username_invalid: Invalid username: 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, or underscores.
errors.display_name_invalid: Display name is required, max 50 characters.
errors.age_required: Tick the statement that you are 18 or older.
errors.legal_outdated: The terms or privacy policy were just updated. Reload the page and accept the latest version.
errors.invalid_name: Names may only contain letters, spaces, dots, commas, apostrophes, or hyphens (2–100 characters).
errors.invalid_input: Some fields are invalid. Please check again.
errors.invalid_doc_path: The KTP photo could not be processed. Upload it again.
errors.doc_missing: The KTP photo has not been uploaded. Upload it again.
errors.consent_failed: The agreement could not be recorded. Try again.
errors.file_type: Unsupported photo format. Use JPG, PNG, or WebP.
errors.file_too_large: Photo is too large. Use a photo of at most 5 MB.
errors.upload_failed: Photo upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.payload_too_large: Too much data. Shorten your input.
errors.balance_remaining: Your wallet still has a balance. Withdraw it before deleting your account.
errors.payout_in_progress: A withdrawal is still in progress. Wait until it finishes.
errors.fulfillment_in_progress: A reward claim is still being processed. Wait until it finishes.
errors.refused: Your account cannot be deleted yet. Settle your balance or ongoing withdrawals first.
errors.admin_account: Admin accounts can only be deleted by a super admin.
